title: Ghosts in the Ruined Cinema
description: Two women stand in the center of a derelict, graffiti-covered room with a collapsed ceiling. One woman is translucent like a ghost while the other is solid, both wearing vintage purple dresses. A vintage film projector on a stone pedestal casts a beam of light, with film reels, strips, and cans scattered across the cracked floor.
prompt: Two women in vintage purple dresses stand inside a decaying concrete room with a large hole in the ceiling revealing overgrown foliage. One woman is a translucent ghost, the other is solid and touching her. A large vintage film projector on a stone pedestal projects a beam of light. Film reels and strips are scattered on the cracked floor. The walls are covered in colorful murals and graffiti. Surreal, atmospheric, cinematic lighting.
